notes.subject: ונהרו
notes.rationale: Root נהר: 'to sparkle/be radiant' (KJV 'were lightened', JPS 'were radiant') vs 'to flow/stream' (Geneva 'runne to him', LXX ἐ illumined); the sheen of a running stream underlies both.

notes.subject: dipono
notes.rationale: פנים is literally 'faces' (the part that turns); rendered with the Sepedi plural of 'face/visage', losing the Hebrew singular-of-majesty 'their face was not ashamed'.

translation: Ba betetše go yena gomme ba khantšhitše, gomme dipono tša bona a di ke tša tshwarwa ke mahloni.

tokens.gloss: di ke tša tshwarwa ke mahloni
